title: Guard by census: read whole, every hour, the lawless systems where our miners work
note: Written by Apophis 2026-11-16 05:16 UTC (orders.log ENT-012, block APOPHIS (2): one drone in every system beyond the border where our miners work, hunting a herd there or flying its census, until the guard runner exists, requests.log ENT-070). The systems: those of the mine routes beyond the border in game/routes/ (routes group paying, zone beyond, 2026-11-16 05:16 UTC). A read renews the herd counts of the hunts there (the dispatcher trusts a census for 90 minutes) and records every pilot met beside our miners (data/intel/sightings.jsonl); with --stay the drone ends in the system it read. A patrol's fuel is the price of the picture (orders F16): census-frontier cost about 630 cr per ship-hour (52 runs in 4 hours, hive.py standing, 2026-11-16 05:00 UTC); two ships, so about 1,300 cr an hour, reported every turn. Empty hold beyond policed space (F13).
